title: Skin System Men — customer reviews (data/reviews.json)
description: Only add REAL reviews you have permission to publish. The testimonials section stays hidden while the array is empty.

name.description: As the customer wants to be shown, e.g. 'Mike R.'

guide.description: Guide slug (oily-acne, early-aging, razor-irritation, dull-skin, pores-texture, maintenance, all-guides) or the guide name

photo.description: Optional path to a photo the customer agreed to share, e.g. img/reviews/mike.jpg

incentivized.description: true if the customer got the guide for free in exchange for an honest review (shows a disclosure)
